fusions.name: Flung Crockery
fusions.desc: Hurls a crock that deals 14 blunt damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 2.5 tiles. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Overturned Board
fusions.desc: Heaves the board over, dealing 32 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, plus 5% of the maximum health of any boss or elite it hits. You restore 14 health.

fusions.name: Gorged Frame
fusions.desc: Raises your maximum health by 20% for 20 seconds. You restore 15 health when you cast it.

fusions.name: Muscle on the Bone
fusions.desc: When you gain health, your physical damage rises by 30% for 6 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
